title: Visual Verdict
description: Vision-model judgment of whether the Baseline-to-Candidate visual change matches intent. Produced by the visual-judge agent. One verdict per (capture_ref, viewport) pair. Consumed by browser-checker (embedded in browser-check-result v2 captures[]) and build-runner (blocking/needs_eyes routing).

verdict.description: Final verdict. 'expected': change matches declared intent or zero-diff shortcut applied. 'regression': unintended change detected (desktop regression blocks the task). 'unexpected': change present but not a clear regression (becomes needs_eyes, does not block). 'uncertain': judges could not reach 2-of-3 majority (becomes needs_eyes, does not block).

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation of the verdict. For panel verdicts this is the majority's rationale. Fed into the build-runner retry loop on 'regression'.

viewport.description: Viewport name from the Check Spec (e.g. 'desktop', 'mobile'). Matches the viewport name in check-spec-schema viewports[].name.

capture_ref.description: Capture name this verdict applies to. Matches the capture step name field in check-spec-schema and the captures[].name field in browser-check-result v2.

panel_votes.description: Individual judge votes. Contains 1 entry for the screener-only path (screener returned 'expected') or 3 entries when the full panel ran (any non-expected screener result). Majority of 3-vote panels determines the final verdict; no majority yields 'uncertain'.

model.description: Model ID of the judge (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-5'). Informational — used for calibration.

rationale.description: This judge's rationale. Delta-only: judges evaluate only the Baseline-to-Candidate change, not pre-existing aesthetics.

examples.rationale: Button color changed from gray (#9CA3AF) to brand blue (#2563EB). The diff is confined to the primary action button. No structural or layout changes detected.

panel_votes.rationale: The only visible change is the button color update. This matches the declared expected_visual_change: present and the diff is limited to a single UI element.

examples.rationale: Nav bar collapses on desktop viewport at 1440px. The left sidebar overlaps the main content area. Two of three judges agree this is an unintended layout regression.

panel_votes.rationale: Sidebar overlap on desktop is clearly unintended. Content is obscured.
Desktop layout is broken. The sidebar was not present in the Baseline.
Layout changed but unclear if intentional without more context.

examples.rationale: Judges could not reach a 2-of-3 majority. Requires human review.

panel_votes.rationale: Font size change appears intentional for mobile readability.
Font change was not expected on mobile only.
Text is now smaller on mobile, reducing readability.
